sourceQuote: Applicants to the Pre-Economic Management Program (entry in September each year) must have HSK3 or above or appropriate Chinese language proficiency. Applicants for the spring session (entry in March each year) must have HSK4 or above or appropriate Chinese language proficiency.
targetQuote: 申请预经济管理项目者（每年HSK September入学）须达到3或以上水平，或具备适当的中文语言能力。申请春季班者（每年HSK March入学）须达到4或以上水平，或具备适当的中文语言能力。
